verdict.rationale: Paxos documents an Identity API for onboarding persons (KYC) and institutions with required members (KYB), each returning an onboarding decision that clears the counterparty for Paxos-powered services. It also documents beneficiary-information collection for above-threshold crypto transfers and automated review of fiat accounts before they can be used. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that identity status gates sending and receiving before funds move, identity-status webhooks or decision-handling detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
